title: How to donate
content: Donors can sign in through the donor portal and submit one-time or monthly gifts. The portal supports preset donation amounts and custom contributions so supporters can choose what fits their budget.

title: How to contact the team
content: For direct help, users should use the contact page. It is the best place to send questions that need a response from the team.

title: About and programs page
content: The About page explains the organization's mission and programs. It is the main place to learn what services and support areas are highlighted on the website.

title: Where donations go
content: Donation spending is allocated to direct program areas that support safe housing, counseling, education support, and related care services. The transparency section emphasizes that funds are tied to real program outcomes.

title: Transparency and accountability
content: The organization communicates trust through annual financial reporting, independent audits, and regular updates to donors. This helps supporters understand the impact of their contributions.

title: Privacy and safety commitment
content: Resident safety is prioritized with privacy-first practices. Identifying resident information is not publicly shared, and systems are designed around protecting minors and survivors.

title: Cookie policy page
content: The cookie policy page explains how cookie consent works on the site and what cookies are used for website functionality and user experience.

title: Admin and donor portal access
content: Users can access protected areas through portal routes and login pages. Admin and donor pages require authentication and are separate from public website pages.

title: Account login and registration pages
content: The website includes login and registration flows for account access. Donors also have a dedicated donor login page.

title: When exact details are needed
content: If a visitor needs exact details or information not shown publicly on the website, they should use the contact page for direct support.
